goal: SBOM gate: a complete software bill of materials produced for each release.
use: SBOM gate: a complete software bill of materials produced for each release. Use when a release is built.

steps.note: Confirm the SBOM is generated by the pipeline for each release.
Set the rule. A release without an SBOM does not pass.
Check completeness. The SBOM must include transitive packages.
Check storage. The SBOM is kept with the release record.
Report. The release, the SBOM status, its component count and any gap.
